knowledge_items_qa_ck.name: knowledge_items_qa_ck
knowledge_items_qa_ck.value: "knowledge_items"."kind" <> 'qa' OR ("knowledge_items"."prompt" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge_items"."body" IS NOT NULL)

knowledge_items_event_ck.name: knowledge_items_event_ck
knowledge_items_event_ck.value: "knowledge_items"."kind" NOT IN ('event', 'origin') OR ("knowledge_items"."label" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge_items"."date_kind" IS NOT NULL)

knowledge_items_list_ck.name: knowledge_items_list_ck
knowledge_items_list_ck.value: "knowledge_items"."kind" <> 'list' OR ("knowledge_items"."label" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge_items"."list_values" IS NOT NULL)

knowledge_items_brand_ck.name: knowledge_items_brand_ck
knowledge_items_brand_ck.value: "knowledge_items"."kind" <> 'brand' OR ("knowledge_items"."label" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge_items"."raw_text" IS NOT NULL)

knowledge_items_years_ck.name: knowledge_items_years_ck
knowledge_items_years_ck.value: "knowledge_items"."year_from" IS NULL OR "knowledge_items"."year_to" IS NULL OR "knowledge_items"."year_to" >= "knowledge_items"."year_from"

knowledge_links_recipe_uq.name: knowledge_links_recipe_uq
knowledge_links_recipe_uq.where: "knowledge_links"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "knowledge_links"."recipe_id" IS NOT NULL

knowledge_links_category_uq.name: knowledge_links_category_uq
knowledge_links_category_uq.where: "knowledge_links"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "knowledge_links"."category_id" IS NOT NULL

knowledge_links_ingredient_uq.name: knowledge_links_ingredient_uq
knowledge_links_ingredient_uq.where: "knowledge_links"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "knowledge_links"."ingredient_id" IS NOT NULL

knowledge_links_product_uq.name: knowledge_links_product_uq
knowledge_links_product_uq.where: "knowledge_links"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "knowledge_links"."product_id" IS NOT NULL

knowledge_links_one_target_ck.name: knowledge_links_one_target_ck
knowledge_links_one_target_ck.value: ("knowledge_links"."recipe_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("knowledge_links"."category_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("knowledge_links"."ingredient_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("knowledge_links"."product_id" IS NOT NULL) = 1

products_price_basis_ck.name: products_price_basis_ck
products_price_basis_ck.value: "products"."purchase_price_cents" IS NULL OR "products"."purchase_price_basis" IS NOT NULL

reference_specs_costs_ck.name: reference_specs_costs_ck
reference_specs_costs_ck.value: ("reference_specs"."garnish_cost_ht_cents" IS NULL OR "reference_specs"."garnish_cost_ht_cents" >= 0) AND ("reference_specs"."material_cost_ht_cents" IS NULL OR "reference_specs"."material_cost_ht_cents" >= 0) AND ("reference_specs"."sale_price_ttc_cents" IS NULL OR "reference_specs"."sale_price_ttc_cents" >= 0)

source_citations_sheet_uq.name: source_citations_sheet_uq
source_citations_sheet_uq.where: "source_citations"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "source_citations"."sheet_id" IS NOT NULL

source_citations_table_row_uq.name: source_citations_table_row_uq
source_citations_table_row_uq.where: "source_citations"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "source_citations"."table_row_id" IS NOT NULL

study_guides_import_key_uq.name: study_guides_import_key_uq
study_guides_import_key_uq.where: "study_guides"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "study_guides"."import_key" IS NOT NULL
